gloss: winning someone over by crying; tearful persuasion

definitions.gloss: winning someone over by crying; tearful persuasion; using tears to get one's way
definitions.explanation: A persuasion tactic where someone cries or makes an emotional plea to get what they want. Often implies manipulation or insincerity.

examples.japanese: {泣|な}き{落|お}としで{頼|たの}む。
{泣|な}き{落|お}としにあって、つい{許|ゆる}してしまった。
examples.english: Subjected to a tearful plea, I ended up forgiving them.

examples.japanese: {泣|な}き{落|お}としが{通|つう}じるような{相手|あいて}ではないとわかっていたが、{他|ほか}に{方法|ほうほう}がなかった。
examples.english: I knew he wasn't the type to be swayed by tears, but I had no other option.

notes:
USAGE:
Generally carries a negative nuance of manipulation. The person using this tactic may or may not be genuinely upset — the emphasis is on using emotion as a tool of persuasion.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {泣|な}き{落|お}としにあう (to be subjected to tearful persuasion)
- {泣|な}き{落|お}としが{通|つう}じる (tearful persuasion works)
- {泣|な}き{落|お}としで〜する (to do something by tearful pleading)
- {泣|な}き{落|お}とし{作戦|さくせん} (the crying strategy)
